question: When a species x stop cell jumps from silence to CallingIndex 3 after recent rain, is that full chorus mainly a reactivation of a physical site where the same species was recorded in other years?
population: Frozen NAAMP matched pairs restricted to pairs with identical nonmissing SiteID at all ten StopNumbers.
focal_units: Cells with dry CallingIndex=0 and wet CallingIndex=3.

leave_pair_out_memory.same_site_prior_full_chorus: In another eligible run of the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum, excluding the focal wet/dry runs, the same species reached CallingIndex 3 at the same SiteID.
leave_pair_out_memory.same_site_other_call: The species was detected at the same SiteID in another eligible run, but never at CallingIndex 3 there outside the pair.
leave_pair_out_memory.route_only_recurrent: The species was detected in another eligible run of the same stratum but not at the focal SiteID.
leave_pair_out_memory.one_off_stratum_record: The species was never detected in any other eligible run of the same stratum outside the pair.

primary_models: Each pair-level component uses the existing matched-pair model with rain_contrast, temperature_difference, day_of_year_difference, year_gap, State and RunNumber; route-clustered covariance.
primary_rule: Known-site chorus reactivation is supported if (same_site_prior_full_chorus + same_site_other_call) has complete 95% CI >0 and contributes >50% of the total new_ci3_count rain coefficient.

prior_only_sensitivity.definition: Repeat memory classification using only eligible runs strictly earlier than the earlier survey year of the matched pair.
prior_only_sensitivity.gate: >=1500 pairs and >=300 routes with at least one prior eligible run in the same stratum.

interpretation: Support means rainfall-associated full choruses recur primarily at sites where the species has been acoustically recorded in other years.
A prior full chorus at the same site is stronger evidence of recurrent chorus-site use than a prior lower CallingIndex.
Repeated acoustic detection does not prove continuous occupancy or reproductive success between surveys.
No causal rainfall or physiological mechanism is identified.
